<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Ackroyd Family Plumbing | Plumbers in Leeds</title>
<meta name="description" content="Family-run plumbers in Leeds. Boiler repairs, emergency leaks, bathrooms and drains. Gas Safe registered, fixed-price quotes, and a real person answers the phone.">
<style>
  :root {
    --navy: #14303f;
    --navy-deep: #0c1f2a;
    --teal: #1f6f78;
    --copper: #c26a3a;
    --copper-light: #f3d9c8;
    --cream: #faf6f0;
    --paper: #ffffff;
    --ink: #1d2a31;
    --muted: #5d6b73;
    --line: #e7e0d6;
    --radius: 14px;
    --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(12, 31, 42, 0.12);
    --max: 1160px;
  }

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    color: var(--ink);
    background: var(--cream);
    line-height: 1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }
  h1, h2, h3 {
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    line-height: 1.2;
    margin: 0 0 .5em;
    color: var(--navy-deep);
  }
  h1 { font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem); font-weight: 700; }
  h2 { font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 3vw, 2.4rem); font-weight: 700; }
  h3 { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; }
  p { margin: 0 0 1em; }
  a { color: var(--teal); }
  img, svg { display: block; }

  .container { width: min(100% - 2.5rem, var(--max)); margin-inline: auto; }
  section { padding: clamp(3.5rem, 7vw, 5.5rem) 0; }
  .eyebrow {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: .8rem;
    letter-spacing: .14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--copper);
    margin-bottom: .75rem;
  }
  .lead { font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--muted); max-width: 60ch; }
  .section-head { max-width: 680px; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
  .section-head.center { margin-inline: auto; text-align: center; }
  .section-head.center .lead { margin-inline: auto; }

  /* Buttons */
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: .55rem;
    padding: .9rem 1.4rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    border: 2px solid transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform .15s ease, background .2s ease, color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .btn:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid var(--copper);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }
  .btn-primary { background: var(--copper); color: #fff; }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: #ad5a2c; }
  .btn-ghost { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.55); color: #fff; }
  .btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); }
  .btn-dark { background: var(--navy); color: #fff; }
  .btn-dark:hover { background: var(--navy-deep); }
  .btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; }

  /* Top bar */
  .topbar {
    background: var(--navy-deep);
    color: #cfd9de;
    font-size: .9rem;
  }
  .topbar .container {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: .55rem 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .topbar strong { color: #fff; }
  .topbar a { color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 700; }
  .pulse {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 8px; height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #5fd38d;
    margin-right: .4rem;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(95,211,141,.6);
    animation: pulse 2s infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse {
    0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(95,211,141,.6); }
    70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(95,211,141,0); }
    100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(95,211,141,0); }
  }

  /* Header */
  header.site {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 50;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.96);
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  header.site .container {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: .9rem 0;
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; text-decoration: none; color: var(--navy-deep); }
  .brand-mark {
    width: 42px; height: 42px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal), var(--navy));
    display: grid; place-items: center;
  }
  .brand-mark svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
  .brand-name { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.1; }
  .brand-name small { display: block; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; }

  nav.main ul {
    list-style: none;
    display: flex;
    gap: 1.6rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }
  nav.main a {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--ink);
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: .95rem;
  }
  nav.main a:hover { color: var(--copper); }
  .header-cta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; }
  .header-cta .btn { padding: .65rem 1.1rem; font-size: .95rem; }

  /* Hero */
  .hero {
    position: relative;
    background:
      radial-gradient(900px 500px at 85% -10%, rgba(31,111,120,.55), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(700px 500px at -10% 110%, rgba(194,106,58,.35), transparent 60%),
      linear-gradient(160deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-deep) 100%);
    color: #e8eef1;
    padding: clamp(4rem, 8vw, 6.5rem) 0 clamp(4.5rem, 9vw, 7rem);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .hero h1 { color: #fff; }
  .hero .eyebrow { color: var(--copper-light); }
  .hero .lead { color: #c4d1d8; }
  .hero-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.15fr .85fr;
    gap: 3rem;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .hero-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .9rem; margin-top: 2rem; }
  .hero-points {
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .6rem 1.4rem;
    margin-top: 2rem; padding: 0; list-style: none;
    font-size: .95rem; color: #d6e0e5;
  }
  .hero-points li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; }
  .hero-points svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: #5fd38d; }

  .hero-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 1.8rem;
    backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  }
  .hero-card h3 { color: #fff; font-size: 1.3rem; }
  .hero-card .status {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem;
    font-size: .9rem; color: #bfe9cf; margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
  .queue { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 1.4rem; }
  .queue li {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    padding: .9rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
    font-size: .95rem;
  }
  .queue li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  .queue span:first-child { color: #d6e0e5; }
  .queue .tag {
    font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; padding: .25rem .6rem; border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(95,211,141,.18); color: #bfe9cf;
  }
  .queue .tag.busy { background: rgba(242,178,91,.2); color: #ffd9a8; }
  .hero-card .btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
  .hero-card small { display: block; text-align: center; margin-top: .8rem; color: #9fb2bc; font-size: .82rem; }

  /* Trust strip */
  .trust {
    background: var(--paper);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .trust-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 1.5rem;
    padding: 2rem 0;
  }
  .trust-item { display: flex; gap: .9rem; align-items: flex-start; }
  .trust-icon {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 12px;
    background: var(--copper-light);
    color: var(--copper);
    display: grid; place-items: center;
  }
  .trust-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
  .trust-item strong { display: block; color: var(--navy-deep); font-size: 1rem; }
  .trust-item span { font-size: .9rem; color: var(--muted); }

  /* Services */
  .services { background: var(--cream); }
  .service-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 1.4rem;
  }
  .service-card {
    background: var(--paper);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 1.8rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
    transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  }
  .service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); border-color: transparent; }
  .service-card .ico {
    width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 14px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal), var(--navy));
    display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 1.1rem;
  }
  .service-card .ico svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; color: #fff; }
  .service-card p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .97rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .service-card .more {
    margin-top: auto; font-weight: 700; color: var(--teal); font-size: .95rem;
  }
  .service-card.emergency { background: var(--navy); border-color: var(--navy); }
  .service-card.emergency h3 { color: #fff; }
  .service-card.emergency p { color: #c4d1d8; }
  .service-card.emergency .ico { background: var(--copper); }
  .service-card.emergency .more { color: var(--copper-light); }

  /* About */
  .about-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 4rem;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .family {
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, #e9f1f2, #f6ebe1);
    border-radius: 24px;
    padding: 2.5rem;
    position: relative;
  }
  .family-row { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 1.2rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .person { text-align: center; width: 110px; }
  .avatar {
    width: 88px; height: 88px; margin: 0 auto .6rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: grid; place-items: center;
    font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(12,31,42,.18);
    border: 4px solid #fff;
  }
  .person:nth-child(1) .avatar { background: var(--navy); }
  .person:nth-child(2) .avatar { background: var(--teal); }
  .person:nth-child(3) .avatar { background: var(--copper); }
  .person:nth-child(4) .avatar { background: #6b8f71; }
  .person strong { display: block; font-size: .95rem; color: var(--navy-deep); }
  .person span { font-size: .82rem; color: var(--muted); }
  .since {
    margin-top: 2rem; padding-top: 1.5rem; border-top: 1px dashed #c9bfb1;
    display: flex; justify-content: space-around; text-align: center;
  }
  .since div strong { display: block; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.8rem; color: var(--copper); }
  .since div span { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); }
  .about-copy ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 1.5rem 0 0; }
  .about-copy li {
    padding-left: 2rem; position: relative; margin-bottom: .8rem; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .about-copy li::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: .45rem;
    width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--teal);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(31,111,120,.15);
  }
  .signature { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; color: var(--navy); margin-top: 1.5rem; font-size: 1.1rem; }

  /* Process */
  .process { background: var(--paper); }
  .steps {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 1.5rem;
    counter-reset: step;
    position: relative;
  }
  .step {
    position: relative;
    padding: 1.8rem 1.4rem;
    background: var(--cream);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .step::before {
    counter-increment: step;
    content: counter(step);
    display: grid; place-items: center;
    width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--copper); color: #fff;
    font-weight: 700; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
  .step h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; }
  .step p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .94rem; margin: 0; }

  /* Pricing */
  .pricing-note {
    margin-top: 2rem; padding: 1.2rem 1.5rem;
    background: var(--copper-light); border-radius: var(--radius);
    color: #5a2f16; font-size: .95rem;
    display: flex; gap: .8rem; align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .pricing-note svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; }
  .price-table {
    width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: var(--paper);
    border-radius: var(--radius); overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  }
  .price-table th, .price-table td {
    text-align: left; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .price-table th { background: var(--navy); color: #fff; font-size: .9rem; letter-spacing: .03em; }
  .price-table td:last-child, .price-table th:last-child { text-align: right; font-weight: 700; }
  .price-table td small { color: var(--muted); display: block; font-weight: 400; }
  .price-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }

  .pricing-wrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .9fr 1.1fr; gap: 3rem; align-items: start; }

  /* Reviews */
  .reviews { background: var(--cream); }
  .review-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 1.4rem;
  }
  .review {
    background: var(--paper);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 1.8rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  }
  .stars { color: #e2a33b; letter-spacing: 2px; font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: .8rem; }
  .review blockquote { margin: 0 0 1.2rem; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--ink); flex-grow: 1; }
  .review cite { font-style: normal; font-size: .9rem; color: var(--muted); }
  .review cite strong { color: var(--navy-deep); display: block; }
  .rating-summary {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem;
    margin-top: 2.5rem; color: var(--muted); flex-wrap: wrap; text-align: center;
  }
  .rating-summary strong { font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--navy-deep); font-family: Georgia, serif; }

  /* Areas */
  .areas { background: var(--navy); color: #d6e0e5; }
  .areas h2 { color: #fff; }
  .areas .eyebrow { color: var(--copper-light); }
  .areas .lead { color: #b5c5cd; }
  .area-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3rem; align-items: center; }
  .chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .6rem; }
  .chip {
    padding: .5rem 1rem; border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
    font-size: .95rem; color: #fff;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  }
  .chip small { color: #9fb2bc; margin-left: .3rem; }

  /* Contact */
  .contact { background: var(--paper); }
  .contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .9fr 1.1fr; gap: 3rem; align-items: start; }
  .contact-details { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 2rem 0 0; }
  .contact-details li { display: flex; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.4rem; }
  .contact-details .ico {
    flex-shrink: 0; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px;
    background: var(--cream); color: var(--teal);
    display: grid; place-items: center;
  }
  .contact-details .ico svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .contact-details strong { display: block; color: var(--navy-deep); }
  .contact-details span, .contact-details a { color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; }
  .contact-details a:hover { color: var(--copper); }

  .hours {
    margin-top: .5rem;
    width: 100%;
    font-size: .95rem;
    border-collapse: collapse;
  }
  .hours td { padding: .25rem 0; color: var(--muted); }
  .hours td:last-child { text-align: right; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }

  form.quote {
    background: var(--cream);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 2.2rem;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  }
  .form-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem; }
  .field { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .field label { display: block; font-weight: 700; font-size: .9rem; margin-bottom: .35rem; color: var(--navy-deep); }
  .field input, .field select, .field textarea {
    width: 100%;
    font: inherit;
    padding: .8rem .95rem;
    border: 1.5px solid #d7cfc2;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #fff;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .field textarea { min-height: 110px; resize: vertical; }
  .field input:focus, .field select:focus, .field textarea:focus { border-color: var(--teal); }
  form.quote .btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.05rem; }
  .form-foot { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; margin-top: .9rem; }
  .form-success {
    display: none; margin-top: 1rem; padding: 1rem;
    background: #e3f5ea; color: #195b33; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; text-align: center;
  }

  /* Emergency banner */
  .banner {
    background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--copper), #a4522a);
    color: #fff;
    padding: 2.2rem 0;
  }
  .banner .container {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .banner h2 { color: #fff; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 2.6vw, 2rem); margin: 0; }
  .banner p { margin: .3rem 0 0; color: #fbe5d8; }
  .banner .btn-dark { background: #fff; color: var(--navy-deep); }
  .banner .btn-dark:hover { background: var(--copper-light); }

  /* Footer */
  footer {
    background: var(--navy-deep);
    color: #9fb2bc;
    padding: 3.5rem 0 1.5rem;
    font-size: .93rem;
  }
  .foot-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2.5rem;
    padding-bottom: 2.5rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  }
  footer h4 { color: #fff; font-size: .95rem; margin: 0 0 .9rem; letter-spacing: .03em; }
  footer ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
  footer li { margin-bottom: .5rem; }
  footer a { color: #c4d1d8; text-decoration: none; }
  footer a:hover { color: var(--copper-light); }
  footer .brand-name { color: #fff; }
  footer .brand-name small { color: #7d919b; }
  .foot-bottom {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem;
    padding-top: 1.5rem; font-size: .85rem; color: #7d919b;
  }
  .badges { display: flex; gap: .6rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 1rem; }
  .badges span {
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); padding: .35rem .7rem; border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: .8rem; color: #c4d1d8;
  }

  /* Mobile call bar */
  .mobile-call { display: none; }

  /* Responsive */
  @media (max-width: 1000px) {
    nav.main { display: none; }
    .hero-grid, .about-grid, .pricing-wrap, .contact-grid, .area-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .trust-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .service-grid, .review-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .steps { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .foot-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .header-cta .btn-secondary-desktop { display: none; }
    .service-grid, .review-grid, .steps, .trust-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .form-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .foot-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .topbar .hide-sm { display: none; }
    form.quote { padding: 1.5rem; }
    .since { gap: 1rem; }
    body { padding-bottom: 64px; }
    .mobile-call {
      display: flex; position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 60;
      background: var(--copper); color: #fff; text-decoration: none;
      justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: .6rem;
      padding: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem;
      box-shadow: 0 -6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
    }
    .mobile-call svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
  }
</style>
</head>

<!-- Reusable inline SVG symbols -->

<script>
  // Set current year
  document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

  // Lightweight form handling (replace with real backend or form service)
  const form = document.getElementById('quoteForm');
  const success = document.getElementById('formSuccess');

  form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    let valid = true;
    form.querySelectorAll('[required]').forEach((field) => {
      const ok = field.value.trim() !== '';
      field.style.borderColor = ok ? '' : '#c0392b';
      if (!ok) valid = false;
    });
    if (!valid) {
      const firstInvalid = form.querySelector('[required]:invalid, [required][style*="rgb(192"], [required][style*="#c0392b"]');
      if (firstInvalid) firstInvalid.focus();
      return;
    }
    form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]').disabled = true;
    success.style.display = 'block';
    form.reset();
    setTimeout(() => {
      form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]').disabled = false;
      success.style.display = 'none';
    }, 6000);
  });
</script>
